**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is interested in beautiful islands to visit near Terengganu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pulau Redang is known for its crystal-clear waters and white sandy beaches; accessible by ferry from Kuala Terengganu.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pulau Perhentian is famous for its coral reefs and marine life; reachable by speedboat from Kuala Besut.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pulau Lang Tengah is an idyllic island with beautiful beaches and reefs; accessible by speedboat from Merang Jetty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pulau Kapas is known for its stunning beaches and laid-back atmosphere; reachable by boat from Marang Jetty.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best ways to get to these islands are by ferry or speedboat; ferries and speedboats are available from Kuala Terengganu and Kuala Besut.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Visitors can hire private boats or take organized tours to these islands.
- [PREFERENCE] User expresses excitement about the islands, stating they sound amazing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For a day trip, Pulau Kapas is a good option as it is the closest island to Terengganu, taking just 30 minutes by boat.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pulau Kapas offers a quiet and relaxing atmosphere, making it excellent for sunbathing, swimming, and snorkeling.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Another option for a day trip is Pulau Lang Tengah, accessible by a 45-minute speedboat ride from Merang Jetty, with fewer visitors and excellent snorkeling and diving opportunities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Spending more time on the islands is highly recommended to enjoy the beauty and activities offered.
- [EVENT] User plans to go for a day trip to Pulau Kapas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are dining options available on Pulau Kapas, including resorts with their own restaurants offering local and international cuisines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are also small local eateries on Pulau Kapas selling seafood, barbecues, and snacks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User is advised to bring snacks and drinks for the day trip to ensure food availability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended to carry reusable water bottles and refill them from fresh water sources on the island to reduce plastic waste.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are equipment rental shops on Pulau Kapas for snorkeling gear and other water sports equipment like kayaks and stand-up paddleboards.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Some resorts on Pulau Kapas offer rental equipment, and local rental shops cater to tourists.
